notes.subject: טובו / יפיו
notes.rationale: Suffix 'his' vs 'their' (KJV/ASV 'his' vs JPS 'their' — God's or the flock's goodness); Bambara uses 'a' which keeps the singular.

notes.subject: דגן בחורים
notes.rationale: Grain and young men: either 'grain for the young men' (KJV) or 'grain will make the young men flourish' (ASV/JPS) — rendered with the verb of ינובב distributed over both pairs.

notes.subject: תירוש
notes.rationale: Must/fresh grape-juice, not necessarily fermented — 'diwɛn kura' keeps the freshness sense.

notes.subject: כי
notes.rationale: Causal/exclamatory particle rendered as 'sabu' opening an exclamation rather than plain 'for'.

translation: Sabu a ka ɲumanya ka bon a wa, ani a ka kaɲi ka bon! Kisɛ bɛna denmisɛnw balo, ani diwɛn kura bɛna denmusow balo.
